data.one_liner: Discover the state of network connectivity (WiFi, mobile, ethernet) on Android, iOS, Web and desktops.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to check the current network connectivity status and listen to connection changes in real-time. It supports various connection types such as mobile, Wi-Fi, ethernet, VPN, bluetooth, and satellite across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need to detect if the device is connected to Wi-Fi, cellular, or other networks
Your app needs to react to network connection state changes via a stream
avoid_when: You are relying solely on connectivity status to guarantee actual internet access or reachability
You need detailed Wi-Fi SSID or MAC address details on platforms where privacy restrictions block it
strengths: Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux
Provides both a one-time check and a real-time event stream
Flutter favorite package with regular updates
weaknesses: Connection type availability does not guarantee actual internet access
Web implementation has browser limitations and relies on experimental APIs or fallback to online status
Background connectivity changes are not communicated on Android O and above
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum Flutter >=3.19.0, Dart >=3.3.0, iOS >=13.0, macOS >=10.15, and Java 17.
